newsitem.title: USA: Fla. 620 MW Seminole power plant seen back Wed.
newsitem.headline: Fla. 620 MW Seminole power plant seen back Wed.

text.p: A 620 megawatt (MW) unit at the coal-fired Seminole generating station was expected to resume operation Wednesday, sources familiar with the plant's operation said.
The Palatka, Fla., power unit was shut October 14 for seasonal maintenance.
The neighboring unit 2, also rated at 620 MW, was planned to return to service next week after being last month for maintenance, the sources said.
The Seminole generating facility is owned and operated by Seminole Electric Cooperative Inc.
